title: QIAseq FastSelect Extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: Before this protocol the RNA plate should have went through the thermocycler according to FastSelect 5s/16s/23s, Table 3 and placed on a back on the temperature deck on slot 7.

steps.title: Place RNA plate on deck
steps.instruction: Place the RNA plate (which has already been run through the thermocycler according to FastSelect 5s/16s/23s Table 3) onto the temperature deck in slot 7.

steps.title: Place reagent plate on module
steps.instruction: Place the reagent plate onto the temperature module in slot 10; add MasterMix to column 1 and magnetic beads to column 2.

steps.title: Load reservoir with reagents
steps.instruction: Place the reservoir on slot 2 and fill it as follows: Nuclease‑Free Water in well 1, Binding Buffer in well 2, Ethanol in wells 3 and 4, and reserve wells 10, 11, 12 for supernatant removal.
